about.title: About
about.intro: I'm a Cybersecurity Analyst & Full-Stack Software Engineer focused on threat detection, security operations, building secure systems and game development.
paragraphs: With 5+ years of experience, I specialize in building secure, scalable SaaS platforms. I helped create Keymint.dev, a developer-first licensing system serving enterprise users; working on secure API design, authentication, digital signatures, JWT, TLS, and cryptographic license validation. My work emphasizes clean code, maintainability, and user experience. I also contributed to the development of Puzzle Scout & Africa's Legends a mobile game app when I was a Game Developer Intern at Leti Arts Ghana.

My cybersecurity interests center on SOC operations, threat detection, incident response, network security, cryptography, and PKI. I work with tools and technologies such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, Wireshark, Linux, Python, and OpenSSL to investigate security events, analyze system activity, and strengthen defensive controls.
about.quote: Every alert tells an interesting story. The challenge is knowing which ones matter.
